tasks.title: NUMA node placement simulator
tasks.statement: The host has two nodes with 8 cores and 32 GiB each. Place the machines of two scenarios: choose which nodes their CPUs run on and where their memory lives, and reach the required share of remote accesses without exceeding the node resources. The exercise is solved when both placements are accepted.
tasks.hint: Keep a machine's CPUs and memory on the same node; stretch a machine that does not fit in one node across both and enable virtual NUMA topology.
